test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Compensate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4 is:** 'Compensate'.**
 
• In this context, **"compensate" **is the best choice.
 
• The s**entence reads**: "So one consequence is that melting glaciers help to compensate for low rainfall in times of drought, filling reservoirs to supply the nation's water supply."
 
• **This implies** that the melting glaciers serve to offset or make up for the lack of rainfall during drought periods.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'In Switzerland these glacial meltwaters are used for hydropower. In fact, water falling on 93% of Switzerland ultimately passes through at least one electric power plant before even leaving the country. So one consequence is that melting glaciers help to **compensate **for low rainfall in times of drought, filling reservoirs to supply the nation's (5) __________ supply.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are not the correct answer:
 
 
• **'Surrender'** - This word typically implies giving up or yielding, which doesn't make sense in this context. The melting glaciers aren't giving up; they're providing a beneficial service.
 
• **'Slate' **- As a verb, 'slate' often means to schedule or plan for something. It doesn't fit well in this context, which requires a verb indicating that the glaciers are making up for a deficiency.
 
• **'Stall' **- This verb typically means to delay or halt progress, which is the opposite of what the melting glaciers are doing. They're not stalling the process; they're helping it along.
